newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to collect $100 a month from foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to collect $100 a month from foreigners.

text.p: Indonesia plans to collect a monthly fee of $100 from foreigners working in the country to help develop the skills of local workers, Manpower Minister Abdul Latief said on Tuesday.
"We will collect $100 a month from foreign workers to develop and improve the skills of Indonesian workers," Latief told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
"$1,200 a year is small. In other countries it is greater than that," he said, adding collection would begin some time next year.
He gave no details on how the fee would be levied or when collection would begin.
He said the Manpower Ministry would set up a special board to devise the best way to use the fund for developing the expertise and skills of Indonesian workers.
Latief said there were currently more than 50,000 foreign workers in Indonesia.
